* Jetpacs Icon Reference

This document lists every Material Design icon resolvable through
=IconMap.kt=.  The companion app uses =material-icons-extended= *1.7.8*
plus its transitive dependency =material-icons-core= — the core artifact
carries the ~50 most common icons (=arrow_back=, =menu=, =close=,
=search=, ...), and a table generated from the extended AAR alone reads
exactly those as nonexistent (the first cut of this table had that bug;
18 of IconMap's 66 pre-seeded names were absent).

The version is pinned in =companion/gradle/libs.versions.toml=
(=compose-icons=): the icons artifacts left the Compose BOM in 2024, so
1.7.8 is the last standalone release and does NOT float with the BOM.

** How IconMap Resolution Works

When a node carries an =icon= member (SPEC 17.1), =IconMap.get()=
resolves the snake_case wire name to a Compose =ImageVector= in this
order:

1. Check the pre-populated cache (66 common icons, instant).
2. Convert =snake_case= to =PascalCase= and try =Icons.Outlined.<Name>= via reflection.
3. Try =Icons.AutoMirrored.Outlined.<Name>= via reflection.
4. Try =Icons.Filled.<Name>= via reflection.
5. If nothing resolves, return =Icons.Outlined.HelpOutline= — SPEC 17.1
   requires an unresolved name to render a harmless placeholder, never
   an error.

Successful reflective lookups are cached for the process lifetime.

Step 5 means a MISSPELLED icon name never fails anything — it silently
renders the placeholder.  =test/jetpacs-icon-lint-test.el= closes that
hole: it extracts every icon literal from the Emacs modules and asserts
membership in this table (plus the IconMap pre-seed), so a typo fails
the suite instead of shipping a question mark.

** Usage in Jetpacs

From Elisp, pass the *snake_case name* to the widget builders:

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
(jetpacs-icon "search")
(jetpacs-icon-button "save" (jetpacs-action "jetpacs.files.save")
                     :content-description "Save")
(jetpacs-chrome-row "Habits" :icon "checklist" :on-tap ...)
#+end_src

On the wire those become =icon= members on nodes (SPEC 17.1):

#+begin_src json
{"t": "icon_button", "icon": "save",
 "on_tap": {"action": "jetpacs.files.save"},
 "content_description": "Save"}
#+end_src

(An earlier revision of this document showed a ={"type": "action-row"}=
example — no such node type exists; the discriminator is =t= and the
shapes are SPEC §17's.)

** Generating This Table

Run the portable generator (python3; requires a populated Gradle cache —
=./gradlew build= in =companion/= first).  It merges BOTH icon
artifacts, and fails loudly if any IconMap pre-seeded name is missing
from the result — the invariant that catches a missing artifact.

#+begin_src sh :results output
python3 generate-icon-table.py --update
#+end_src

** Icon Table

A name appears once: names present as =Icons.Outlined.<Name>= are listed
Outlined (IconMap tries that first); AutoMirrored rows are the
AutoMirrored-exclusive names.
